_comment: DEV-ONLY bundling. These ids are packed into the bundled index for dev builds (predev, manual pack-plugins.sh, check.sh) so you can test plugins offline without publishing, but they are NEVER shipped in a release. Release builds (prebuild, or B3D_RELEASE=1) ignore this file and use only bundle.json. Read by scripts/app-bundle.mjs and scripts/pack-plugins.sh.
_variantDirs_comment: Plugin source dirs (relative to the sibling plugins/ tree) bundled AS-IS by explicit path, NOT by id. This lets one plugin id carry a dev-only channel variant (e.g. an experiment build of fluidd) alongside its online stable atom, which the id-keyed `bundle` list cannot express. Dev-only; a dir whose files/ has not been built yet is skipped.
